Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to provide high-fidelity training simulation, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aRadar Simulation Specialist (d/f/m)You will join a team of experienced engineers and subject matter experts to jointly define, implement and integrate complex simulation sub-systems in the domain of sensors and weapons. Our engineers are closely collaborating with other departments and external suppliers in order to provide solutions for high-fidelity trainings systems, with current focus on the Eurofighter pilot training simulation system PSTS.You will serve as Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored simulation solutions for various radar systems, ranging from versatile, generic model to high-fidelity replicas of actual systems, such as the current Eurofighter MSCAN Radar, as well as future systems such as the Eurofighter ESCAN Radar. Based on your deep technical understanding of actual systems and your knowledge of electronic warfare, you will play a key role in the definition and development of optimal solutions to match simulation and/or training needs while respecting technical limitations of distributed real-time systems. As such, you are closely cooperating with various engineering teams, Chief Engineering and Operational Factors, and will act for Radar-related topics as point of contract for alignments and discussions with the Customer and external suppliers.Major Role & Responsibilities- Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored Radar simulation solutions- Ensuring the technical expertise regarding current and future radar systems, such as Eurofighter MSCAN and ESCAN Radar- Performance of Systems Engineering activities to ensure the viable technical radar solutions meeting the requirements and needs of the overall system.- Technical coordination of external suppliers an alignment with internal stakeholders, such as Chief Engineering, development teams and Operational Factors- Support of the integration and testing activities at the simulation devices in close collaboration of other subject matter experts- Ensuring on-time, cost- and quality-compliant development as well as integration of a consistent and powerful radar simulation across all project phases.- Technical support in the assessment and selection of suppliersSpecific & Technical Skills / Experience Required- Expertise regarding - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar- Eurofighter Training Needs and the current Pilot Synthetic Traning System (PSTS)- Systems engineering (incl. tools such as DOORS)- V-model based SW development process- Extensive Experience in - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test- Eurofighter Training Simulations Solutions (ASTA/PSTS)- Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test- Systems Engineering and V-model based SW development process, including active contribution in integration activities- IT literate (MS Office applications)General Skills / Experience Required- Educated to degree level in computer science or engineering- Good language skills in English, both written and spoken- Strong communication skills with an ability to operate in a multi-cultural environment- Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy while maintaining close, effective collaboration within a multi-disciplinary team.- Capability to respond to changes in activities and priorities- Experience in the alignment with and coordination of various stakeholdersNot a 100% match? Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Lead the certification, qualification and Continued Airworthiness activities for the Electronics and/or Military Avionics technical disciplines.- Provide airworthiness approvals and exercise Design Organisations Approvals (DOA) as well as Military Design Organisation Approvals (MDOA) privileges for the scope of assigned responsibility as delegated by the Office of Chief of Airworthiness.- Be responsible for the timely achievement of certification and qualification milestones through identification of major program technical issues and associated risk management plan, identification of regulation and interpretation issues and identification of safety and certification compliance issues.- Lead the necessary activities for the investigation of incidents and accidents for those aspects regarding Airworthiness technical knowledge.- Provide technical certification knowledge in Electronics and/or Military Avionics to the design organization, or special projects.- Influence the definition of certification policies for the technical discipline under his/her scope, and promote their consistent application across programs, including the participation in the development of new and foreseen technical certification strategies or policies. In particular for novel or unusual design features or for compliance demonstration method improvement.- Represent Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups for technical certification.- Contribute to technical certification de-risking in Airbus Defence and Space Research and Technology (R&T) as well as Research and Development (R&D) projects related to the Airworthiness Technical.- Gather and disseminate Technical Certification regulatory knowledge and expertise within Airbus Defence and Space, particularly for Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) and Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) community, to maintain state of the art.Desired skills and qualifications- Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering.- Extensive professional experience (more than 10 years) in Airworthiness functions related to Electronics and/or Military Avionics discipline.- Experience interfacing with Aviation Authorities is a plus.- Excellent negotiation skills, strong interpersonal and consulting skills.- Ability to understand complex issues and break them down in order to develop solutions independently.- Advanced level of English.- Good knowledge of German language is a plus.Not a 100% match?
